hero.menu: Easy does it! Just give me a hand.

wardrobe.info: Rare items take 3 ad views each
wardrobe.forSection: This item is a reward for finishing a section
wardrobe.info_wheel: This item can be won on the wheel of fortune
wardrobe.info_calendar: This item is the gift for the seventh day in a row

m1.question: Wake Valera up
m1.hint: What in the house was made specially for waking people?
m1.wrong: Zzz… Leave me be, I'm asleep.
m1.win: Huh? What? Okay, okay, I'm up! Oh, for crying out loud…

m2.question: Valera can't open his eyes
m2.start: My eyes won't open. It's dark!
m2.hint: Something shines through the window in the morning. But something is in its way.
m2.win: Whoa, the sun! Right in my eye! Okay, I'm awake.

m3.question: Find the second slipper
m3.start: I've got one slipper. Where's the other?
m3.hint: The cat looks a bit too comfortable. You can move him.
m3.wrong: That's not a slipper. I know my slippers!
m3.win: There it is! Whiskers, that's not a pillow.

m4.question: How many socks does Valera have?
m4.start: Count carefully. I lost track myself.
m4.hint: Socks are not only on the floor. Take a look at Valera himself.
m4.wrong: That doesn't add up. Did you count the ones on me?
m4.win: Five! Three on the floor and two on me. Still no matching pair.

m5.question: Make Valera some coffee
m5.early: An empty mug! I don't drink air.
m5.poured: Oh, that smell! Hand it over.
m5.hint: First the coffee goes into the mug. Then the mug goes to Valera.
m5.wrong: Oh, come on, not like that!

m6.question: Brush Valera's teeth
m6.early: A brush with no toothpaste? Not fair.
m6.paste: There it goes. Now give me the brush.
m6.hint: Toothpaste gets squeezed: press the tube and hold. Then bring the bristles of the brush to his mouth.
m6.wrong: Nope. I'm brushing teeth, not that.

m7.question: Valera is running late. Help him
m7.hint: If there's not enough time, you can… wind it back. Turn the clock hand.
m7.wrong: Wrong way! Now I'm even later!
m7.win: Easy does it! Plenty of time now.

m8.question: Help find the keys
m8.start: Where are my keys? They were right here!
m8.hint: The keys are right in front of you. Read the task again, one word at a time.
m8.wrong: Not there. I already looked. Twice.
m8.win: There they are! In plain sight the whole time.

m9.question: The shirt is wrinkled
m9.start: I can't go out looking like this.
m9.hint: Wrinkles hate an iron. Rub it over the shirt.

m10.question: Valera lost his glasses
m10.start: I can't see a thing! Where are my glasses?
m10.hint: Glasses usually are where you pushed them yourself. Look at Valera more closely.
m10.wrong: Not there. Though without glasses I can't see what's there.
m10.win: On my forehead?! Oh, come on. Tell no one.

m11.question: The fridge is empty. Feed Valera
m11.start: I'm starving. And the fridge is a desert.
m11.hint: A fridge has more than one door. Look where it's colder.

m12.question: Cook the dumplings
m12.start: Dumplings don't cook themselves. I checked.
m12.potOn: Pot is in place. What's next?
m12.earlyKnob: The stove is heating nothing! Pot first.
m12.earlyPelmeni: Into cold water? That's not how we do it.
m12.hint: Just like at home: pot on the stove, then the heat, then the dumplings.
m12.wrong: That's not how you cook, come on!

m13.question: The cat won't let Valera out
m13.start: Whiskers, move. I have to go to work!
m13.found: Oh, sausage. I'd eat it myself…
m13.hint: The cat will leave the door if you offer something more interesting than a door. Check the fridge.
m13.win: Deal. Sausage is the entry fee.

m14.question: The lift is broken. How many floors will Valera walk down from the 9th to the 1st?
m14.start: On foot. From the ninth. Oh, come on.
m14.hint: From the ninth to the eighth is one floor. Count the trips, not the floors.
m14.wrong: I counted with my legs, and it doesn't add up.
m14.win: Eight! My legs ache, but it's exercise.

m15.question: It's raining and there is no umbrella
m15.hint: You don't need an umbrella if there is no cloud. The screen isn't that big.
m15.win: Beautiful! No cloud, no umbrella needed.

m16.question: Catch the bus
m16.hint: Only Valera can run here. Hurry him along: fast, and many times.
m16.wrong: Not that! The bus is leaving!
m16.win: Made it! Phew… The early bird… I forget the rest.

m17.question: Pay the fare
m17.start: My wallet has zero. Absolutely zero.
m17.hint: Valera has no money. Do you? Look at what's on the screen besides the bus.
m17.win: Thanks, you saved me! I'll pay you back on payday.

m18.question: Don't sleep through the stop
m18.start: Zzz… wake me at the factory…
m18.hint: Don't press Stop right away. Press it when the place Valera is going to shows up in the window.
m18.win: The factory! We're here. Easy does it.

m19.question: The guard won't let Valera in without a pass
m19.start: My pass… I had a pass somewhere…
m19.hint: Valera has the pass on him. It's just hanging the wrong way round.
m19.wrong: No pass, no entry. I know!
m19.win: There it is! Around my neck the whole time.

m20.question: The boss is coming! Make it look like Valera has been working for hours
m20.start: Zzz… I'm not sleeping, I'm thinking…
m20.pillowOff: What pillow? There was no pillow.
m20.hint: A working man wears a hard hat and holds a tool. And there should be nothing soft nearby.
m20.wrong: No time for tea! The boss is coming!

f1.question: Start the machine
f1.start: The shift has begun. The machine won't start itself.
f1.hint: The big button is being honest. Look for something smaller on the side.
f1.wrong: It says do not touch! Oh, come on.

f2.question: Hide Valera from the boss
f2.start: The boss is coming! And I'm not working yet!
f2.hint: It's Valera who needs hiding. You can pick him up and carry him.
f2.win: I'm not here. I'm a crate.

f3.question: Hand over the size 12 wrench
f3.hint: The right wrench is not in sight. What here is lying in the wrong place?
f3.wrong: That's not a twelve! Can you read numbers?
f3.win: There it is! Under a part, as usual.

f4.question: Find 5 differences between the two parts
f4.start: One is faulty. Find how it differs.
f4.hint: Compare the right part with the left, spot by spot: what's missing, what's extra, what has another colour, size or shape.
f4.win: Five out of five! Quality control needs you.

f5.question: Tighten the bolt
f5.hint: Bolts are tightened in a circle. Move your finger around it, clockwise.
f5.wrong: You're loosening it! The other way!
f5.win: Tight! It won't fall off now. Probably.

f6.question: Fire in the break room!
f6.start: Fire! My soup is on fire!
f6.hint: There's something red on the wall for exactly this.
f6.wrong: With tea?! Be serious. This needs more!
f6.win: It's out! The soup has foam now, though.

f7.question: How many parts are on the conveyor?
f7.start: The boss will ask. I need the exact number.
f7.hint: The conveyor doesn't end at the edge of the screen. Look at the very edges.
f7.wrong: That doesn't add up. Did you check the edges?
f7.win: Six! Two are halfway gone, but they count.

f8.question: The boss needs 100 parts, and Valera has 99
f8.start: One is missing. Where did I put it?
f8.hint: The last part is on Valera. Where does a working man keep what matters most?
f8.win: Under my hard hat! I hid it from the rain.

f9.question: Warm up lunch
f9.start: Lunch is cold. And there's no microwave.
f9.hint: A factory is full of hot things. One pipe is glowing with heat.

f10.question: Fix the pipe
f10.start: It's leaking! And I've got nofing to plug it wiff!
f10.hint: The hole needs sealing with something. Look at what Valera is chewing.
f10.wrong: You can't plug a hole with a wrench!
f10.win: It holds! Gum is the best sealant.

f11.question: Valera fell asleep. Wake him quietly
f11.start: Zzz… the plan… we'll meet it…
f11.hint: No noise, the boss will hear. What wakes you with a smell, not a sound?
f11.wrong: RIIING! Quiet! The boss will hear!
f11.win: Mmm, coffee… Huh? I wasn't asleep, I was thinking!

f12.question: Take the crate to the warehouse
f12.start: The crate is heavy. I only have one back.
f12.early: And who's going to drive? The forklift won't drive itself.
f12.hint: Too heavy by hand. There's a machine for this, but it needs a driver.
f12.wrong: No, I'll hurt my back like that!

f13.question: The sign says: 5 + 5 × 0 = ?
f13.start: This puzzle decides the bonus. Don't let me down.
f13.hint: Multiply first. Whatever you multiply by zero, what do you get?
f13.win: Five! Zero ate everything, but the five stayed.

f14.question: Collect the bonus
f14.start: The window is shut. They're on a break.
f14.hint: Knocking on accounting is useless. Only patience works here.
f14.wrong: Don't knock! Now the wait is even longer.
f14.win: It opened! There's my bonus. Beautiful!

f15.question: Who ate Valera's lunch?
f15.start: My cutlets are gone. It was one of these three.
f15.hint: Whoever ate it left the evidence on his own face.
f15.wrong: Not him. He has an alibi.
f15.win: Crumbs on the moustache! Got you, Petrovich.

f16.question: Get through the turnstile
f16.start: My pass is acting up again.
f16.hint: The turnstile only lets you through on green. Don't rush.
f16.wrong: Bang! Forehead into the turnstile. Oh, come on.

f17.question: Salary: −5000 (fine)
f17.hint: The digits are fine. One small sign in front of them is the problem.
f17.wrong: Leave the digits! I need those.
f17.win: Plus five thousand! Now we're talking.

f18.question: Which gear will start turning last?
f18.start: The motor turns the first one. You figure out the rest.
f18.hint: The turning passes along the chain from the motor. And one gear touches nothing, so it will never turn at all.
f18.wrong: Not that one. Follow the chain from the motor.
f18.win: The fourth! And the fifth just lies there, like me at lunch.

f19.question: Prove to the boss that Valera was working
f19.start: I need to look tired. Right now.
f19.dirty: Oil on the hard hat. Getting there.
f19.sweat: Dripping with sweat! Well, sort of sweat.
f19.part: A broken part on the bench. I was fixing it.
f19.hint: A man who worked is dirty, sweaty, and has a part on his bench.
f19.win: "Valera, take a rest, you work too hard!" Beautiful.

f20.question: End of shift! Leave before the boss does
f20.start: Five o'clock. And he just stands there watching.
f20.early: He is looking right at me!
f20.distracted: He turned away! Now or never.
f20.hint: You can't reach the door while the boss is watching. Distract him, with a crash for example.
f20.win: I'm out! See you tomorrow, dear factory.

d1.question: Make Valera handsome
d1.start: I have a date! And a bird's nest on my head.
d1.hint: Messy hair fears a comb. Run it over his head.

d2.question: Pick a bouquet
d2.start: I need flowers. I have no money. But there's a lawn.
d2.hint: The yellow ones will do. The purple ones prick.
d2.wrong: Ouch! A thistle! You don't give those.
d2.win: Bouquet done! Modest, but from the heart.

d3.question: Get to the café
d3.start: I won't make it on foot. What can I ride?
d3.hint: There's a ride standing nearby. Valera himself has to get on.
d3.wrong: No, I won't get there like that.
d3.win: Off we go! Wind in my moustache.

d4.question: Find Dasha: she is wearing a red scarf
d4.start: We met online. I've never seen her.
d4.hint: There's a lot of red here. Only one of them has a scarf.
d4.win: Dasha! I knew you at once. Almost.

d5.question: Open the door for Dasha
d5.start: Allow me, gallantly… and it won't open.
d5.hint: It's written on the door. You don't push it, you pull it towards you.
d5.wrong: It won't open! What does the sign say?
d5.win: After you! I'm a gentleman, you know.

d6.question: Make Dasha laugh
d6.start: She's bored. I must do something.
d6.hint: Jokes won't help. Rock Valera himself: fast, several times.
d6.win: Crash! Fell off the chair. But Dasha is laughing.

d7.question: Valera spilled juice on his shirt
d7.start: Oh, come on! My only shirt!
d7.hint: The stain is fresh. Rub it with a napkin.
d7.win: Good as new! Dasha didn't notice a thing.

d8.question: What's her name? Valera forgot
d8.name: DASHA
d8.start: I forgot! Nerves wiped it clean.
d8.hint: Asking would be awkward. But her name is written on one of her things.
d8.win: Dasha! Of course, Dasha. I never forgot.

d9.question: Dasha doesn't like flowers: she is allergic
d9.start: That sneeze is for my bouquet. So what do I give her?
d9.found: Oh, chocolate! I was saving it for a rainy day.
d9.hint: Flowers won't do. Valera has something better tucked in his pocket.

d10.question: Pay for dinner
d10.start: The bill is here. And I have zero again.
d10.hint: Valera's pockets are empty. But something jingles at the top of the screen.

d11.question: Don't break the vase
d11.start: Oh no! The vase is falling!
d11.hint: You can't catch the vase. But you can put something soft where it lands.
d11.wrong: Smash! Good thing that was a rehearsal.

d12.question: Make friends with Dasha's cat
d12.start: Here, kitty… He looks at me like my boss.
d12.hint: Cats like long strokes. Keep your finger on him.

d13.question: Dasha's dad is back! Hide Valera
d13.hint: Dad will check the closet and the bed first. But not a coat rack.
d13.win: I'm not Valera. I'm a coat rack.

d14.question: Distract Dad
d14.start: He's pacing the room. He'll spot me soon.
d14.hint: Football will distract Dad. But the remote is missing: someone is sleeping on it.
d14.win: Goal! Dad has no time for me now.

d15.question: Dad: "Whose boots are these?"
d15.hint: No boots, no questions. The screen isn't endless.
d15.win: What boots? There were no boots.

d16.question: Dad: "Who ate the cutlets?"
d16.hint: The evidence is right on Valera. You can brush it off.
d16.win: Clean as a whistle. The cutlets were tasty.

d17.question: Dad: "And who are you?!"
d17.hint: He needs a respectable job. Put in Valera's hand what people bring on a house call.
d17.wrong: With flowers? Then he's a suitor for sure!
d17.win: I'm the plumber! Here to fix the tap.

d18.question: Then fix the tap
d18.hint: The tap drips because it isn't shut. Turn the valve clockwise.
d18.wrong: It's leaking more! The other way!
d18.win: No more drips! I really am a plumber.

d19.question: Dad challenges Valera to arm wrestling
d19.start: His arm is the size of my leg.
d19.hint: Force won't work. But Dad is ticklish: fast, and many times.
d19.win: Victory! Tickling is the smart man's weapon.

d20.question: Dasha is waiting on the balcony for flowers
d20.start: Dad said yes! But what do I bring her?
d20.hint: Everything you need is already in the task. Read it word by word.

k1.question: Valera wants dumplings at night. Find the fridge
k1.hint: Move your finger over the dark, it shines. Look for the tallest white thing.
k1.win: There it is! The dumplings are waiting.

k2.question: There are 4 dumplings on the table. The cat ate one. How many dumplings did Valera eat?
k2.start: A trick question. I can feel it.
k2.hint: Read it again: who ate what? There's not a word about Valera.
k2.win: Zero! I only just sat down, and Whiskers was faster.

k3.question: Valera fell asleep on the bus. Don't wake him!
k3.hint: The hardest thing is doing nothing. Hands off and wait.
k3.win: What a nap! Though I ended up at the depot.

k4.question: Find the TV remote
k4.start: Football starts in a minute! Where's the remote?
k4.hint: The remote is always somewhere soft. Move things around.

k5.question: Valera is on a diet. Get the dumplings out of sight
k5.start: I'm on a diet. But they are looking at me.
k5.hint: He'd find them in the fridge. You need a place he can't reach: beyond the edge of the screen.
k5.wrong: The fridge is the first place I'd look!
k5.win: Out of sight, out of mind. Almost.

k6.question: Valera ate half the dumplings, then half of what was left. 5 remain. How many were there?
k6.start: I was counting, but lost track at the third one.
k6.hint: Work backwards: before the second helping there were twice as many as now.
k6.wrong: That doesn't add up. Count from the end.
k6.win: Twenty! That was a good pack.

k7.question: Take a photo of Whiskers
k7.start: He's hiding in the bushes. Catch the moment!
k7.hint: Don't press right away. Wait until the cat shows up from the bushes.
k7.wrong: That's a bush. A pretty one, but not a cat.
k7.win: Great shot! Whiskers is not amused.

s1.question: Who is the main character here?
s1.hint: The main character stands off to the side, modestly quiet.
s1.win: Me! Of course it's me! Thanks for noticing.

s2.question: Who is rustling in the bushes?
s2.start: Someone is there. I'm not scared. Almost.
s2.hint: One bush is moving. You can rub a bush away with your finger.
s2.win: Whiskers! How did you get here?

s3.question: Valera is having a nightmare. Rub it out
s3.hint: What does Valera hate every single morning? Rub it with your finger.
s3.wrong: No, no, that's the nice part! Bring it back!
s3.win: The alarm clock is gone! Back to sleep. Beautiful.

s4.question: Scratch off the grey layer
s4.start: A lottery! I'm about to be rich.
s4.hint: The grey layer rubs off like a scratch card. Rub it with your finger.
s4.win: A sock?! Well, now I have six.

achievements.streak7: Log in 7 days in a row
